Subject: OnRamp Action Timeline — initial MAP template & kickoff doc

Hi Sophie — great chatting yesterday. As promised, I attached a starter Mutual Action Plan tailored for OnRamp that we can iterate in Google Docs. The idea: a one-page milestone timeline (pilot -> evaluation -> purchase), a short evaluation checklist for your platform team, and a compact RACI for stakeholders.

What I'm sharing:
- onramp_map_template.gdoc — editable MAP with recommended milestones and roles
- onramp_timeline_slide_deck_v0.pptx — 2-slide summary you can drop into your internal deck

Quick asks:
1) Can you confirm target pilot start week (you mentioned late Sep vs early Oct)?
2) Who from OnRamp should be on the technical evaluation checklist (access + security contacts)?

If it helps, I can propose a 6-week evaluation cadence with clear acceptance criteria for the pilot (sample acceptance criteria included in the doc). I copied Aditya to loop in the demo and SLA discussion.

Thanks — will follow up with a trimmed checklist and a version for your execs.

Best,
Mina Haddad

Thanks Mina — this is helpful. I reviewed the draft quickly and appreciate the compact milestone view. A couple of notes from our side:
- We have an exec review week of Sep 13 — ideally the pilot needs to be scoped and a clear success metric set before then.
- Can you include an evaluation checklist that covers security (SOC2 evidence), data residency options, and expected token egress (approx monthly)? Our infra lead (Thomas) will need that to clear the pilot.
- We can likely start the pilot the week of Sep 20 if scope and legal playbook are green. If Redwood can bias to a Sep 13 internal visibility milestone, that would help get us to purchase fast.

I attached a short summary of internal stakeholders; I'll add the full security contact details in a follow-up.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sophie
Sophie Klein | Head of Product Ops | OnRamp Technologies
sophie.klein@onramptech.com

Subject: Re: OnRamp — draft MAP changes and checklist (internal)

Team — Sophie pushed for a Sep 13 exec visibility milestone and wants pilot scoped to start Sep 20 if legal + security check out. She also asked for a security checklist (SOC2 evidence, data residency, token egress estimates).

Proposed changes to the MAP template before we send v1 to OnRamp:
- Add a two-column evaluation checklist: "Must have" (SOC2 report, infra contact, data retention policy) + "Nice to have" (fine-grained RBAC, private VPC option).
- Replace generic "pilot start" with concrete weeks: Exec visibility (2026-09-13), Pilot kickoff (2026-09-20), Pilot completion review (2026-10-31).
- Add acceptance criteria for pilot: 1) avg 95th pct  latency <= 350ms for 1k concurrent qps simulated load; 2) integration of key auth flows (SAML/OIDC); 3) no P0 security findings.

Draft checklist (paste into GDoc):
- SOC2 report (latest) — Delivered by Redwood team (link)
- Data residency options — Confirmed region(s) and enclosure
- Token egress estimate — Projected monthly tokens and billing delta
- SAML/OIDC integration test with sample assertions
- Audit log access and retention policy
- Contact list for escalations (Redwood + OnRamp)

Can Aditya please confirm the latency acceptance language and whether the 1k concurrent QPS is realistic for the pilot? Marissa — please slot in a short slide summarizing the acceptance criteria we can send to their execs. Lauren — flag any legal/contract items we need to pre-clear (NDA amendments / minimal terms).

If everyone signs off, I'll update the GDoc and send v1 to Sophie + Thomas on Mon morning.

Thanks — Mina

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@onramptech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: OnRamp Action Timeline — MAP v1 and short pilot summary

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clarity on dates and stakeholders. We've incorporated your asks and attached a cleaned-up MAP + a one-page scope slide. Highlights below and links to the live doc:

Summary (pilot path)
- Exec visibility: 2026-09-13 (internal OnRamp review)
- Pilot kickoff: 2026-09-20 (1–2 week setup + ingestion work)
- Pilot run: 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-25 (4 weeks of evaluation)
- Pilot review & decision: 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-02

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Performance: median < 100ms, 95th percentile < 350ms at simulated peak (target profile attached)
- Security: SOC2 evidence shared; SAML/OIDC integration verified; no P0 findings
- Outcomes: success when evaluation queries pass customer-defined quality checks (we included sample prompts to validate responses)

Shared items (links & attachments):
- MAP v1 (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OnRampDraftMAP
- Scope slide (PDF): onramp_scope_slide_v1.pdf
- Pilot token estimate and sample load profile: included in the doc

Attachments: onramp_map_v1_gdoc (Google Doc link), onramp_scope_slide_v1.pdf

Next steps:
- Sophie: confirm final security contact for the checklist (Thomas?), and confirm you have internal buy-in for Sep 13 visibility.
- Aditya: planning call to confirm demo + SLA language (can you propose 2 times next week?)
- Mina: will schedule a short 30-minute kickoff working session once we have the security contact.

If agreed I will also create a short HubSpot activity and attach the MAP to the deal record (RDW-8342-ONR).

Best regards,
